# Fair Code

> Fair Code exposes and fixes bias in real-world AI systems - criminal justice, hiring, lending, healthcare, welfare eligibility, tenant screening. Open-source audits with measurable results, up to 97% bias reduction.

Created and maintained by Yash Kewlani ([github.com/yakew7](https://github.com/yakew7)). Source: [github.com/yakew7/Fair-Code](https://github.com/yakew7/Fair-Code).

Full text of every explainer in one file (for AI answer engines): https://www.thefaircode.xyz/llms-full.txt

> Status: development is fully open - new audits, explainers, and tooling all merge normally. `paper/results-frozen/` (tag `v1.0-paper`) is kept only as a reference snapshot ahead of a real paper submission planned for next year.

## Audits

- [COMPAS](https://www.thefaircode.xyz/#projects): Criminal justice recidivism scoring. ProPublica's public dataset, 70,000+ records.
- [AI Hiring](https://www.thefaircode.xyz/#projects): Women hired 20.9% less than equally qualified men in a hiring model.
- [German Credit Lending](https://www.thefaircode.xyz/#projects): A lending model rates young applicants as bad credit risks, learning age from job tenure.
- [Insurance Denial](https://www.thefaircode.xyz/#projects): A healthcare AI flags older patients for high-cost claims; BMI, smoking, and diabetes status encode race.
- [Benefits Denial](https://www.thefaircode.xyz/#projects): An automated welfare means-test flags male applicants as ineligible based on marital status.
- [Healthcare Readmission](https://www.thefaircode.xyz/#projects): A hospital readmission model uses payer code and discharge destination as proxies for insurance access.
- [Tenant Screening](https://www.thefaircode.xyz/#projects): A rental screening model uses criminal history in ways that encode race and over-policing.

## Tools

- [Open Dataset Profiler](https://www.thefaircode.xyz/profiler.html): Profiles any dataset for bias risk before modeling.
